svg.aria-label: Vertical commons: plan and section bubble study
svg.title: Vertical commons: plan and section bubble study
svg.desc: Proposed bubble relationships, not measured plans. South pedestrian entrance and east ramp to underground parking are constant. Every option pairs a ground diagram with above-ground and B1 sectional relationships.

g.text: Nest shared places between the floors
N up · actual mapped plot outline; bubbles are not room footprints
C1 trace is on the common-brief locator; this approach is schematic.
South at left · north at right · proposed organisation, not measured form
C / Shared indoor voids connect selected floors
Diagram only: building shape, heights, slabs, core and ramp remain to be designed.
A stepped sequence of voids links the floors visually.
Public galleries sit between learning and work layers.
A terrace connects to growing at the upper level.
The southern and eastern doors meet at a compact lobby.
Cafe, display and a demonstration space animate the ground.
A visible lift and stair lead toward shared upper places.
Gives the strongest vertical exchange within a compact body.
Public life could retreat upstairs; voids consume floor area.
South pedestrian door + east ramp to underground parking.
B1 → lift / stairs → shared welcome; east walk-in door retained.
Basement feasibility and how it is counted remain design checks.
SCHEMATIC / bubble size does not represent area. Outline is a mapped reference; no footprint or setback compliance is asserted.
